title: LOOP
text:
LIBERATION OF OPPRESSED PEOPLE
LOOP empowers youth, families, and justice impacted communities through education, opportunity, resources and community
support.
Mission
LOOP provides youth, families, and justice impacted communities with education, stable housing, essential resources, and meaningful
opportunities that create pathways to independence and lasting success.
WHAT WE DO
Education and Youth Development
Academic support, entrepreneurship education, financial literacy, mentorship and enrichment opportunities.
Housing and Stability
Safe, stable housing and supportive services that help individuals and families move toward independence.
Reentry Support
Resources and practical support for justice impacted individuals rebuilding their lives and returning to their communities.
Family and Court Support
Community based support for families navigating courts, incarceration and other systems.
Transportation and Family Connection
Transportation that helps families stay connected to incarcerated loved ones and access essential services.
Community Resources and Opportunity
Resources, partnerships and opportunities that promote long term stability and growth.
LOOP Summer Academic and Entrepreneurship Camp
A free six week summer program for 20 youth combining academic enrichment, financial literacy, entrepreneurship, real world business exposure, and hands on learning.
Students will develop a business idea, create a business plan and budget, build their brand, participate in educational field trips, source materials, pitch their ideas, receive
startup support, launch their businesses and sell their products at LOOP Youth Business Expo.

title: LOOP - About
text:
ABOUT LOOP
Built from lived experience. Rooted in community. Committed to creating pathways forward.
OUR STORY
LOOP was created from lived experience and a firsthand understanding of the challenges youth, families, and justice impacted individuals face when navigating
complex systems. This understanding shaped a vision for an organization that provides meaningful support, creates opportunities, and strengthens individuals,
families, and communities.
LOOP turns community needs into action and pathways forward.
OUR APPROACH
We believe lasting change starts with listening to communities and understanding their needs. LOOP centers dignity, connection, and. opportunity in our work,
partnering with individuals, families and communities to create solutions that promote stability and long term growth.
OUR VALUES
COMMUNITY
We believe strong communities are built through connection, collaboration, and collective care.
ACCESS
We work to reduce barriers and ensure resources, education, and opportunities are within reach for the communities we serve.
EMPOWERMENT
We believe people should have the tools, knowledge, and support to shape their own future.
DONATE TODAY

title: LOOP - Programs
text:
OUR PROGRAMS
Creating opportunities through education, access, and community centered support.
YOUTH ENTREPRENEURSHIP
LOOP empowers middle and high school youth with entrepreneurial education, financial literacy, and hands on experience. Through our programs and camps,
youth learn how to turn ideas into real businesses and build brighter futures.
COURT & FAMILY SUPPORT
LOOP supports individuals and families navigating the justice system by providing court support, access to resources, and community based assistance
throughout challenging legal processes.
VISITATION TRANSPORTATION
LOOP provides transportation to prisons and county jails, helping families overcome travel barriers and stay connected with their incarcerated loved ones through
in person visits.
REENTRY
LOOP supports individuals returning home after incarceration by connecting them with resources, services and opportunities that promote stability,
independence, and successful reintegration into the community.
HOUSING
LOOP is working to expand access to safe and stable housing for individuals and families facing housing barriers, with supportive services designed to promote
long term stability and independence.
PARTNER WITH LOOP
Businesses, organizations, and community partners can support LOOP programs through sponsorships, resources, volunteer involvement, and collaborative
opportunities.

title: LOOP_Website_Brief
text:
LOOP WEBSITE BRIEF
Liberation of Oppressed People
Website content, structure, programs, and design direction
Organization Name
Liberation of Oppressed People (LOOP)
Website Purpose
LOOP is a nonprofit helping youth, families, and justice-impacted individuals overcome barriers
through housing, reentry, education, transportation, employment, family support, and community
resources.
Overall Website Goal
The website should feel like a real, established nonprofit organization: professional, trustworthy,
community-centered, powerful, modern, and easy to navigate. It should clearly communicate who
LOOP serves, what we do, how people can receive help, and how others can volunteer, partner, or
donate.
Main Website Pages
   Home
   About LOOP
   Programs
   Get Help / Request Support
   Volunteer
   Partner With Us
   Events
   Donate
   Contact
Homepage Layout
At the very top, use a strong hero section with the LOOP logo, a powerful photo or video showing
community, families, youth, court support, housing work, or outreach, and a short statement
explaining what LOOP does.
Place clear call-to-action buttons directly below the hero section:
   Get Support
   Volunteer
   Partner With LOOP
   Donate
Follow with a short “Who We Are” section and then display LOOP’s main programs visually in
separate cards or sections.
Include an impact section showing what LOOP is currently doing in the community, upcoming
programs and events, volunteer opportunities, and photos. Leave room to add future impact
statistics such as families served, youth served, housing support provided, transportation trips, court
support provided, and other measurable outcomes.
About Page
Explain why LOOP exists, our mission, our values, the communities we serve, and the barriers we
are working to reduce.
Core values:
   Community
   Access
   Empowerment
Programs Page
Each program should have its own description and be designed so it can eventually expand into its
own dedicated page or section.
Court & Community Support
Providing court accompaniment, courthouse outreach, resource navigation, community outreach,
and support for individuals and families navigating the justice system.
Visitation Transportation
Helping reduce transportation barriers for families visiting incarcerated loved ones at prisons and
county jails.
Housing Support & Stability
Helping individuals and families overcome housing barriers through resource navigation,
transitional housing support, housing referrals, and connections to safe and stable housing
opportunities.
Reentry Support
Connecting justice-impacted individuals with employment, transportation, resources, referrals, and
other services needed to rebuild stability.
Youth Entrepreneurship & Education
Hands-on programs that introduce middle and high school students to entrepreneurship, financial
literacy, business development, leadership, teamwork, and career possibilities.
Family Support
Supporting families impacted by incarceration and the justice system through resources, referrals,
events, transportation, and community-based support.
Community Outreach & Events
Community resource events, care markets, youth forums, outreach campaigns, volunteer projects,
and other grassroots initiatives.
Get Help / Request Support Page
Include a simple, mobile-friendly form where people can select the type of support they need:
   Court support
   Employment
   Reentry services
   Transportation
   Housing support
   Family support
   Housing/resource referrals
   Youth programs
   Other
Volunteer Page
Visitors should be able to learn about volunteer opportunities and complete an interest form.
Volunteer areas may include courthouse outreach, community canvassing, events, youth programs,
transportation support, administrative help, resource research, housing resource navigation, and
community engagement.
Partner With Us Page
Create a page for businesses, nonprofits, employers, schools, community organizations, sponsors,
housing partners, and other organizations interested in collaborating with LOOP. Include a
partnership inquiry form directly on the page.
Donate Page
Make donating easy and connect the donation button directly to LOOP’s donation platform when
ready. Include a short explanation of what donations help fund, including transportation, housing
support, youth programming, community events, emergency support, program supplies, meals, and
outreach.
Events Page
Feature upcoming camps, workshops, transportation trips, community events, toy drives, youth
events, court outreach, volunteer days, housing-related initiatives, and other LOOP activities.
Media & Content
Use photos throughout the website naturally rather than placing everything in one gallery. A smaller
dedicated photo/media section can also be included.
   LOOP logo
   Photos from community outreach and LOOP activities
   Youth program photos
   Court and community outreach photos
   Housing-related program photos, when available
   Volunteer photos
   Event flyers
   Videos, when available
   Media articles or features, when applicable
Design Style
The site should be modern, bold, clean, professional, and nonprofit-focused. The LOOP logo is black
and white, so the design should work around that branding without feeling dull. Use white space,
strong typography, large photos, clean sections, subtle movement or animation, and bold calls to
action.
Avoid an overly corporate, outdated, cluttered, or generic charity-template look. The website should
look polished on both desktop and mobile, with special attention to mobile users.
Important Website Features
   Mobile-friendly responsive design
   Contact forms
   Volunteer form
   Partnership form
   Support / request assistance form
   Donation integration
   Newsletter or email signup
   Social media links
   Easy updates for events, programs, photos, and announcements
   Basic SEO and Google search setup
   Fast loading
   Secure website / SSL
   Google Analytics or another traffic-tracking tool
   Accessibility-friendly design
What Visitors Should Understand Immediately
   Who LOOP is
   Who LOOP helps
   What LOOP does
   How to receive help
   How to volunteer
   How organizations can partner with LOOP
   How to support or donate
Growth Direction
The website should present LOOP as an organization built to grow beyond one city and eventually
operate programs in multiple communities and states. The site structure should make it easy to add
new locations, programs, events, impact data, and resources over time.
Website Management
The website should be built so LOOP can easily add or update events, photos, programs,
announcements, impact numbers, and other content without needing a developer for every change.
